notes: Native-green 23-assertion directed-interaction sharing and later-module reference witness. Public Create accepts an object-class directedInteraction reference whose class is declared by a later schema-valid module; joined lookup exposes both classes. Public declaration services, object registration, ordinary directed send, and receive callback test one delivery to a discovered subscribed target. Public Create rejects an unresolved class reference and permits valid federation-name reuse. Direct OMT mappings are clauses 4.4.2, 4, and 7; public declaration and delivery mappings are 1516.1 clauses 5.12, 6.14.3, and 6.15.1. The native catalog's PublishSubscribe metadata is not directly introspectable through the public RTI API; federate declaration state is distinct. The single-directed-class fixture avoids the separate multiple-class FDD schema conflict RL-081. Full Annex C merge, Java runtime, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
